نتمازج (form VI)
# نَتَمَازَجُ (natamāzaju) /na.ta.maː.za.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَازَجَ (tamāzaja)
# نَتَمَازَجَ (natamāzaja) /na.ta.maː.za.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَازَجَ (tamāzaja)
# نَتَمَازَجْ (natamāzaj) /na.ta.maː.zad͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَازَجَ (tamāzaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
